decisions.reason: Selecting champagne gold for the É accent changes its color treatment, not its required peak alignment with the Hero V.
Applying champagne gold to the Hero V right arm does not alter the approved Hero V geometry or construction rules.
The Satin Reflection selection is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the distribution decision requires no additional finish-state change.
Coloring the second V right arm champagne gold does not change its established height relationship to the E, L, Hero V, or É accent.
The selective gold treatment does not change the requirement that the É accent use the literal Hero V terminal geometry.
Keeping the remaining elements black does not alter the E and L letterforms' architecture, scale, or customization rules.
Applying champagne gold to the second V right arm changes material distribution only, not the second V's optical construction or character.
The material-distribution choice does not revise which geometric assets are locked or the policy for preserving them across revisions.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY replacing the completed gold-distribution comparison with the requested kerning studies.
The message's kerning change is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the gold-distribution selection adds no further spacing change.
The selective champagne-gold distribution does not alter the established shared-baseline alignment.
The material-distribution selection does not change the all-caps wordmark treatment.
